name: Palia – Zeki's Prize Wheel
description: The prizes of Zeki's Prize Wheel, by prize bag.

items.name: Blue Tornado Firework
items.description: A dynamic firework that corkscrews into a maelstrom of swirling blue lights.

items.name: Butter
items.description: Can't believe it's definitely butter? Well, nuthin's better!

items.name: Cooking Oil
items.description: If you need perfectly browned food, oil always be here for you.

items.name: Giant Ancient Fish Plush
items.description: When you discover an ancient species, obviously you should create MEGA merchandise of it. Now everyone can enjoy their own fishy friend!

items.name: Giant Chapaa Plush
items.description: This HUGE huggable chapaa plush is holding an equally cuddly mushroom, and he's ready to have a good time with his new friend: you!

items.name: Giant Maji Plush
items.description: Bless your home with this cozy plushie of a MEGA Maji, the Dragon! Be soothed by its HUGE, soft presence.

items.name: Heat Root
items.description: Don't sweat it! Whether it's cooking or healing, spicy Heat Root will warm you up from the inside out.

items.name: Pirate Grimalkin Chest
items.description: What better place to store your riches than in a treasure chest? This one once belonged to a notorious Grimalkin pirate.

items.name: Pirate Navigator Maps
items.description: Get your desk set up, because it's time to plan a voyage! This navigator set has everything you need to chart your course.

items.name: Pirate Pilfered Frame
items.description: This painting has certainly had an interesting path through life! From a mansion, to the captain's quarters on a pirate ship, and who knows how many other places. Now, it has found its way to you.

items.name: Pirate Seafaring Kegs
items.description: A set of kegs salvaged from a pirate shipwreck. How'd they survive? Because a container must be as sturdy as its cargo is precious!

items.name: Pirate Ship's Cannon
items.description: With a cannon like this defending your home, those treasure thieves won't know what him 'em! Fire!

items.name: Pirate Ship's Flag
items.description: Fly the flag of Captain Prismbeard on your very own lawn! Eye-catching and fierce in equal measure.

items.name: Pirate Stolen Frame
items.description: Who knows who the original owner of this antique painting might have been? Now, it's yours to display, and perhaps to speculate on its historical mysteries.

items.name: Pirate Tankard
items.description: It doesn't matter what you fill this tankard with, so long as this tankard fills you with the spirit of high-seas adventure.

items.name: Pirate Tattered Cloths
items.description: These cloths might've been pulled from the remnants of a shipwreck's sails. Shabby? No! They're a rugged souvenir of adventure!

items.name: Pirate Wanted Poster
items.description: A wanted poster depicting the infamous Captain Prismbeard! Practically a collector's item in the right circles.

items.name: Pirate's Secret Scroll
items.description: This scroll case alone is enough to spark interest; who knows what mysteries could the scroll within reveal?

items.name: Red Tornado Firework
items.description: A dynamic firework that corkscrews into a maelstrom of swirling red lights.

items.name: Spice Sprouts
items.description: A spicy herb that can be used to add a zing to any dish! They apparently also have medicinal properties, and can help those with any coughs or sniffles.

items.name: Unopened Oyster
items.description: Open up this oyster! Even if you don't find a pearl, you can at least eat it.

items.name: Wild Garlic
items.description: Garlic is a delicious addition to any dish you cook! Or can be eaten raw to perfume one's breath.

items.name: Wild Ginger
items.description: Spicy, sweet, and healing, ginger is valued for both its medicinal and culinary uses. Just don't eat them raw.

items.name: Wild Green Onion
items.description: No meal is complete without a sprinkle of green onion. Chop them up and add them to your dishes to unlock a world of flavor.

items.name: Worn Mouse Plush
items.description: A battered plush that's been stitched back together many times. It has a patch that resembles an eyepatch, just like a pirate! Legend has it, it once belonged to Prismbeard himself.

items.name: Yellow Tornado Firework
items.description: A dynamic firework that corkscrews into a maelstrom of swirling yellow lights.
